recommendation: Keep this fix. Treat broader PRN consistency questions for PlanDefinition, DeviceRequest, or ServiceRequest as separate work group decisions rather than part of this seed reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-37567 was a Published/Persuasive CDS R5 issue asking to add ActivityDefinition.asNeeded 0..1 boolean and ActivityDefinition.asNeededFor 0..* CodeableConcept, plus an example such as ibuprofen as needed for pain or fever.
initial_application: PR HL7/fhir#2288 and commit 608ae761fb52456eb6fb54054ed0bccf719ba8da added ActivityDefinition.asNeeded[x] as a boolean-or-CodeableConcept choice and also added PlanDefinition.asNeeded[x], but did not add an ActivityDefinition example. The retained choice could not express asNeeded=true together with multiple PRN reasons.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini shows ActivityDefinition is active build input. FHIR-34325, already represented on the combined branch, supports the separate asNeeded/asNeededFor PRN pattern and multiple-reason any-condition semantics for Dosage. Focused Jira searches found no separate PlanDefinition asNeededFor issue, and focused Zulip/Confluence searches found no seed-specific guidance that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed ActivityDefinition.asNeeded[x] to ActivityDefinition.asNeeded boolean plus ActivityDefinition.asNeededFor 0..* CodeableConcept with an invariant, preserved the medication-as-needed-reason example binding, added and registered an ibuprofen-as-needed ActivityDefinition example with pain and fever reasons, and updated the checked-in ActivityDefinition diagram label.
source_changes: source/activitydefinition/structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml: split ActivityDefinition.asNeeded[x] into asNeeded and repeatable asNeededFor with invariant and binding.
source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition-ibuprofen-as-needed.xml: added a PRN ibuprofen ActivityDefinition example with pain and fever reasons.
source/activitydefinition/list-ActivityDefinition-examples.xml: registered the new ibuprofen PRN example.
source/activitydefinition/activitydefinition.svg: updated the checked-in ActivityDefinition diagram labels for asNeeded and asNeededFor.
